notes: Research date: 2026-10-08. All entries are proposed mappings, not implemented or runtime-verified claims. expectedSupport is a stage acceptance target derived from declarations; requires-investigation is an explicit unresolved cell.

Extraction uses the exact published native declaration export graph, locally referenced payload/configuration types, generated style fields/operators, explicit experimental shape animator declarations, and RN0.87.1 inherited ViewProps/NativeMethods. Internal React component lifecycle/bridge machinery is inventoried with internal disposition.

The iOS dependency is a wrapper-supported range (~>11.23.1), not an exact resolved SDK pin. A lockfile/build must record the selected SDK before final baseline acceptance. Android SDK default is exact11.23.1.

Native download tokens are no longer required by RNMapbox10.3.7: rnmapbox-maps.podspec documents deprecated RNMapboxMapsDownloadToken; plugin/src/withMapbox.ts declares the download token deprecated and creates an unauthenticated Maven repository unless explicitly given a legacy token. Runtime public access token is separate.

RNMapbox10.3.7 requires React Native New Architecture and Mapbox v11; old architecture and Mapbox v10 are rejected in the podspec. Native RN0.87.1 integration still requires compilation and runtime evidence.

MarkerView10.3.7 documents live React Native child press feedback on both platforms. Android-only stopGesturePropagation opts children out of map gestures; its runtime composition needs verification. Live marker dragging is not declared directly; missing draggable prop does not establish a renderer limitation.

RasterArraySource tileSize and bounds are documented as Android direct options and iOS TileJSON-derived values. Preserve requested behavior using TileJSON where possible and investigate remaining option contracts rather than silently dropping fields.

Camera.triggerKey is explicitly documented as not yet implemented. Strict controlled camera requires real acceptance/rejection/clamping evidence; Camera props alone do not prove the common controlled contract.

Wrapper Style component documents only sources/layers and silently ignores other root fields. one-map-react must route full style documents through owned Map style configuration or reject explicit unsupported options; this wrapper omission does not constrain SDK style-root support.

Offline legacy aliases and cache operations require runtime investigation: documentation includes pre-v10 deprecations, while the frozen baseline is v11. Do not label a stale declaration as successful v11 support.

EXCLUDED: arbitrary native SDK APIs not exported or forwarded by RNMapbox are outside this wrapper inventory. Applicable SDK style schemas/property/operator support are reconciled during S08, alongside public wrapper fields.
